$comment: Screenshots of the documentation (spec 28, M4). Single source of truth shared by the capture pipeline (e2e/docs) and the content (<Screenshot name="..." />). Every entry is captured in light and dark into src/assets/screenshots/{light,dark}/<name>.webp. Route placeholders: {est} establishment id, {date} demo operating date, {mapId}, {bookingId}, {customerId}, {slug}, {manageUrl} (path of a fresh magic link of {bookingId}). Add a name here first, then reference it from the content.
